summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of an extraordinary shareholders' meeting. The agenda includes approving an amendment to Article 20 of the bylaws regarding board composition, renewal, and election, plus instructing the board to align succession policy. The filing details meeting logistics, quorum, voting procedures, and proxy rules. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation. No financial terms, transaction, or strategic event is involved. The filing is procedural and does not trigger any risk-arb or special-situation analysis.
